verdict.rationale: The docs describe a built-in memory system that lets models remember facts, preferences, and context across conversations, and users can manage those memories under Settings > Personalization > Memory. That covers the core of durable cross-session memory. The only explicit documented write path is manual, though, so it is not clear that the AI saves memories on its own. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the model writes memories autonomously, details on how recall works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
